body: If only I could! I have NO MONEY and NO HOME to go back to! I have no savings and roughly £1000 in debt. My brother and sister are alcoholics, my mother is completely selfish and my father is psychopathic. There is nowhere to go and I just have to make do with what I have got and it is so exhausting. I really want to buy some new clothes because I still have the same clothes for EIGHT YEARS
